name: Boler Exception Packet
description: Reconciliation exception — wrong division, duplicate COBRA, terminated-on-roster, carrier rate drift, 401k rate mismatch.

documentSchema.description: Self-contained packet describing one reconciliation exception — what was expected, what was billed, the proposed fix, the $ impact, and the HITL routing decision.
documentSchema.extractionInstructions: Every exception MUST include a proposed_resolution, a confidence score, and a dollar variance. The packet is the evidence Sarah Mitchell or Ziggy Kravitz reviews when they Apply / Override / Remove.

exception_type.description: wrong_division / duplicate_cobra / carrier_drift / terminated_on_roster / k401_rate_mismatch / new_hire_no_cc / auto_fixed_transfer

expected_value.description: What the plan doc / HRIS says

auto_fixable.description: Whether the agent has authority to auto-fix without HITL
